issues.quote: gross profit climbed to $10.4 billion from $10.4 billion
issues.problem: FY2022 gross profit was about $17.5 billion, not $10.4 billion ($10.4B is the FY2021 figure). The stated 64.9% margin only works with $17.5B.

data.summary: Most figures are correct, but FY2022 gross profit is wrong: it should be about $17.5B, not $10.4B, and the stated figure contradicts the 64.9% gross margin.
